revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Professional Basketball
revealWordProblem.text:
The two box plots show the salaries, in millions of dollars, for 15 players on two different professional basketball teams.
Question: A basketball player hopes to be drafted by a professional basketball team. Should he hope to be drafted by Team A or Team B? Use the range and the interquartile range in your answer.
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: Two box plots of player salaries in millions of dollars, one for Team A and one for Team B, drawn on the same number line.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Read the approximate values from the shared salary axis. Team A runs from about $1 million to $20 million, so its range is about $19 million. Team B runs from about $1 million to $40 million, so its range is about $39 million. Team A's box runs from about $2 million to $10.5 million, giving an IQR near $8.5 million. Team B's box runs from a little over $2 million to about $9 million, giving an IQR near $7 million. Team B has the larger overall range but the slightly smaller IQR: its middle half is not more spread out. A player seeking the highest observed salary might prefer Team B, but the plots cannot predict a new player's salary. Either recommendation needs a reason tied to the range and the IQR, rather than treating the maximum as a typical salary.

conceptIntro.heading: Describe Data by Range and Interquartile Range
conceptIntro.intro: One extreme value can stretch the range a lot, but it barely moves the IQR.
conceptIntro.introEs: Un valor extremo puede estirar mucho el rango, pero casi no mueve el RIC.
conceptIntro.keyIdea: The range depends on the two end values, so one extreme value can stretch it. The IQR uses the middle half, so it stays steady.
conceptIntro.keyIdeaEs: El rango depende de los dos valores de los extremos, así que un valor extremo lo puede estirar. El RIC usa la mitad central, así que se mantiene estable.

lines: Seven friends read 6, 7, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 30 books this summer. Find the range and the IQR. Which one better describes most of the data?
Find Q1 and Q3: lower half: 6, 7, 7 → 7; upper half: 9, 10, 30 → 10
The range is 24 and the IQR is 3. The IQR better describes most of the data, because 30 is an extreme value.
A data set has a range of 30 and an IQR of 12. The least value is 64 and Q1 is 75. Find Q3 and the greatest value.
Add the range to the least value: 64 + 30 = 94
Q3 is 87. The greatest value is 94.

Un conjunto de datos tiene un rango de 30 y un RIC de 12. El valor menor es 64 y Q1 es 75. Halla Q3 y el valor mayor.
Suma el rango al valor menor: 64 + 30 = 94
Q3 es 87. El valor mayor es 94.

practice.commonMistake: A common mistake with Range and Interquartile Range is adding the two quartiles instead of subtracting them — writing IQR = Q3 + Q1. With Q1 = 42 and Q3 = 58 that gives 100, which is larger than the data set's entire range of 20. Every measure of variation is a DIFFERENCE, and the IQR can never exceed the range, because the middle half is part of the whole span. If your IQR comes out bigger than your range, you added when you should have subtracted.
